metadata.content:
*Putrid yellow gas explodes from a bomb you toss.*

| **Area, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)**        |                  **Main action** |
|-------------------------|---------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [cube](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cube) within 10** | **🎯 Each creature in the area** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility):**

- **≤11:** 2 poison damage
- **12-16:** 5 poison damage
- **17+:** 7 poison damage

**Effect:** The gas remains in the area until the end of the encounter. Any creature who starts their [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) in the area and has M < AVERAGE is [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) (save ends).
